test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Under which policy has the Union Ministry of Power launched a scheme for procurement of aggregate power of 4500 MW for five years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shakti Policy**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Ministry of Power introduced a scheme for acquiring aggregate power of 4500 MW over five years under SHAKTI Policy.
 
• The purpose is to assist states experiencing power shortages and aid power generation plants in boosting their capacities.</
